At the end of each week, students work with their lab group to compare data, discuss results, and submit a group report. To be assigned to a lab group and matched with a TA, students should complete the following assignments this week (recommended order): Course Introduction Discussion Post Lab Values Survey Lab 1 Discussion Post Lab 1 Report (Individual) In the Course Introduction Discussion Post, students should introduce themselves and clearly state the days and times they are generally available to work on lab experiments and group reports. Students from previous terms consistently report that having group members with similar schedules makes collaboration much easier. Encourage students to provide detailed availability and use the CTRL+F search feature to find classmates with similar schedules. Form a lab group in the “People” tab as explicitly outlined in the “course Introductions” page. Once students have joined a group, they should complete the group's shared Google Doc with their weekly availability. This document will be used to identify times for group meetings and weekly meetings with their TA. The Lab 1 Discussion Post is due on Thursday, so students should fill out their availability as soon as possible and be as accurate as they can. If there are scheduling conflicts, it is important to identify them early.
